description: Use this when you know a company's SIREN and the user wants its identity, or wants to pre-fill a business customer's onboarding form: name, active or ceased, legal form code, NAF code, creation date, head office, establishments, share capital and current officers (name and role only), with sources and update date. Do not use for financial statements, beneficial owners, contact details or people searches, or as a regulatory identity check (KYC); that data is not provided.
name: get_company
title: Get a French company's profile
